about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a software developer with over 10 years of experience building systems and applications for businesses of all sizes. I specialize in creating solutions that are solid, fast, and easy to maintain long-term — whether it's a complex platform for a large company or the website of a business that's just getting started.
